lines.en: Oh, well, you're just the prettiest ballerina I've ever seen.
That deserves another piece of candy.
Well, I have to say, that earns two-two pieces of candy.
Oh. Oh, honey, here, take it all.
- What? - There's only been, like, four kids.
Yeah, I know, but one of them just said that she loved me,
so I just gave her everything.
